parsed.reason: This message fails on multiple critical fronts. It names a technical cause it cannot know ("technical error"), uses incident language ("error"), includes grovelling (emoji), says the request is still queued/running ("still waiting"), hands the parent an errand ("check the app", "try again"), includes a greeting tone ("ok?"), contains a digit ("5 minutes"), and never actually states that nothing was changed. It violates nearly every principle of the intended meaning and Hale's voice.
